answer: A claim is proven by a fresh anchor. The warden publishes a new delta from the ledger after the job starts, and every claim must weave it in. A falcon courier verifies it against the public record in one hour, and a prism split exposes anchors pasted in afterward. A missing or stale anchor is a stale anchor: void, fee burned, barred a week. Honest work costs five cents and one job; 1,000 fakes pay $50 and redo 1,000 jobs live per new delta.
